guide.overview: A powerful **Supporter** and disruptor, The Riddler excels at **shielding allies** and **stacking debuffs** on enemies with **[Enigma]**. He also has the unique ability to **hide your lineup from preview** in certain modes.

legacyPieces.name: Conundrum Cane
legacyPieces.reason: The Riddler's signature gear. Continuously increases all allies' Attack and pairs perfectly with his shields. Also provides steady healing to shielded allies, plus bonus recovery when shields expire, greatly boosting your squad's survivability.

legacyPieces.name: Starheart Staff
legacyPieces.reason: Increases nearby allies' Attack and Physical and Spiritual Defense when The Riddler casts his Ultimate. Since his Ultimate grants shields to all allies, this staff lets the squad gain shields, Attack, Physical Defense, and Spiritual Defense bonuses all at once.

legacyPieces.name: Coluan Force Field Belt
legacyPieces.reason: Increases HP, Physical Defense, and Crit Resistance. The Riddler needs to continuously inflict [Enigma], and high survivability lets him stay in the fight longer to keep weakening foes.

legacyPieces.name: Pied Piper Flute
legacyPieces.reason: Improves healing abilities. The Riddler's Legacy Piece heals shielded allies, so this healing bonus enhances his versatility as a shield-focused Supporter.
